Post 1

Tech bled -2.90% while the rest of the market rallied. ASX 200 closed at 8,735.70, up 0.57%, crossing above its 20-day MA. Breadth was broad — ten of eleven sectors green. One glaring exception. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

🟢 A-REITs led at +1.14%, Materials +0.91%, Utilities +0.90%. 🔴 Info Tech the only real casualty, down 2.90% — a sharp divergence as rate-sensitive real assets outperformed growth. #ASX #ausbiz #REIT #tech

Post 3

📉 Weebit Nano dropped 12.98% to AUD 3.42 — the steepest fall in the index. With Tech already the session's worst sector, the selling had a clear address today. #ASX #ausbiz #tech

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 5,972.81/oz. Silver AUD 87.66/oz. With Materials up 0.91% and Alcoa surging 4.14%, metals momentum is doing real work for the index right now. #ASX #gold #silver #metals #mining

Post 5

ASX 200 is flat year-to-date despite today's 0.57% gain. The 20-day MA cross is a technical line in the sand. Does this hold, or fade by Friday? Drop your level below. #ASX #ausbiz #technicalanalysis
